scenarios.label: No fault

steps.label: node 0 starts an election
notes: Node 0's election timeout fires. It waited long enough without hearing from a leader. A timeout is not a safety decision. A timeout costs one round and nothing more.
Node 0 becomes a candidate at ballot 1.0: it wants the whole log suffix.
Node 0 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0. The promise is durable before anything leaves.
Node 0 campaigns at ballot 1.0. It sends one Prepare to 2 peers, and it claims every slot from 0 at once. Phase 1 asks about no value. It asks what the acceptors have already accepted.

Node 0 asks 2 peers for any slot from 0 it may have missed. It does not claim to be behind. A decision reaches a follower only as a commit watermark. A watermark that it did not receive looks the same as a watermark that was never set.

steps.label: Prepare 1.0
notes: Node 1 receives Prepare 1.0 for every slot from 0. Its promise was 0.0. It holds 0 accepted records to report.
Node 1 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 1.0 is fenced out here from now on.

steps.label: Prepare 1.0
notes: Node 2 receives Prepare 1.0 for every slot from 0. Its promise was 0.0. It holds 0 accepted records to report.
Node 2 raises its durable promise from 0.0 to 1.0, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 1.0 is fenced out here from now on.

steps.label: CatchUpRequest
notes: Node 1 receives a catch-up request from node 0: it is missing everything from slot 0.

steps.label: CatchUpRequest
notes: Node 2 receives a catch-up request from node 0: it is missing everything from slot 0.

steps.label: Promise 1.0
notes: Node 0 receives a Promise for ballot 1.0 from node 1. The Promise reports the 0 accepted values it holds at or above the slot the Prepare asked about.
Node 0 is the leader at ballot 1.0. A promise quorum answered its Prepare. No ballot below 1.0 can decide anything now, and node 0 may run Phase 2 alone.

steps.label: Promise 1.0
notes: Node 0 receives a Promise for ballot 1.0 from node 2. The Promise reports the 0 accepted values it holds at or above the slot the Prepare asked about.

steps.label: the client writes alpha
notes: Client 7 asks node 0 to get alpha chosen. The leader gives it the next free slot, 0, and goes directly to Phase 2. That costs one round trip, because the ballot the leader holds already covers the whole log suffix.
Node 0 records slot 0 = alpha at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.
Node 0 proposes alpha for slot 0 at ballot 1.0, to 2 acceptors. No second Phase 1 is needed. The ballot it holds already covers the whole log suffix.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 1 receives Accept 1.0 for slot 0, carrying alpha. Its promise was 1.0. It holds nothing at slot 0.
Node 1 records slot 0 = alpha at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 2 receives Accept 1.0 for slot 0, carrying alpha. Its promise was 1.0. It holds nothing at slot 0.
Node 2 records slot 0 = alpha at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.

steps.label: Accepted 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 0 at 1.0 from node 1. Its round for that slot held 1 vote before this one.
Slot 0 is chosen. 2 of the 3 acceptors voted for alpha at ballot 1.0. A Phase-2 quorum here is 2 of 3. This decision is final. No later ballot can decide this slot differently.
Node 0 applies slot 0 = alpha. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 0.

steps.label: Accepted 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 0 at 1.0 from node 2. Slot 0 is already chosen here: one more vote changes nothing.

steps.label: Commit 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 1 receives a Commit: slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0. It held alpha at 1.0 there.
Node 1 learns that slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0.
Node 1 applies slot 0 = alpha. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 0.

steps.label: Commit 1.0 · slot 0
notes: Node 2 receives a Commit: slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0. It held alpha at 1.0 there.
Node 2 learns that slot 0 is chosen as alpha at ballot 1.0.
Node 2 applies slot 0 = alpha. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 0.

steps.label: the client writes bravo
notes: Client 7 asks node 0 to get bravo chosen. The leader gives it the next free slot, 1, and goes directly to Phase 2. That costs one round trip, because the ballot the leader holds already covers the whole log suffix.
Node 0 records slot 1 = bravo at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.
Node 0 proposes bravo for slot 1 at ballot 1.0, to 2 acceptors. No second Phase 1 is needed. The ballot it holds already covers the whole log suffix.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 1 receives Accept 1.0 for slot 1, carrying bravo. Its promise was 1.0. It holds nothing at slot 1.
Node 1 records slot 1 = bravo at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 2 receives Accept 1.0 for slot 1, carrying bravo. Its promise was 1.0. It holds nothing at slot 1.
Node 2 records slot 1 = bravo at ballot 1.0. The vote is durable before the Accepted that reports it leaves.

steps.label: Accepted 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 1 at 1.0 from node 1. Its round for that slot held 1 vote before this one.
Slot 1 is chosen. 2 of the 3 acceptors voted for bravo at ballot 1.0. A Phase-2 quorum here is 2 of 3. This decision is final. No later ballot can decide this slot differently.
Node 0 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.

steps.label: Accepted 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 0 receives an Accepted for slot 1 at 1.0 from node 2. Slot 1 is already chosen here: one more vote changes nothing.

steps.label: Commit 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 1 receives a Commit: slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 1.0. It held bravo at 1.0 there.
Node 1 learns that slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 1.0.
Node 1 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.

steps.label: Commit 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Node 2 receives a Commit: slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 1.0. It held bravo at 1.0 there.
Node 2 learns that slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 1.0.
Node 2 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.

scenarios.outcome: Nodes 0, 1, 2 know: slot 0 = alpha, slot 1 = bravo.

steps.label: Accept 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Accept bravo at 1.0 for slot 1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

steps.label: node 0 crashes
notes: Node 0 crashes. Its disk keeps promise 1.0 and 2 accepted records. Its role, its open rounds, its read rounds and its election timer are gone. Leadership is entirely volatile here, so a crash *is* an abdication and needs no durable fence. Nobody re-sends the Phase-2 rounds that were lost with it.

steps.label: Accepted 1.0 · slot 1
notes: Accepted slot 1 at 1.0 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

steps.label: node 1 starts an election
notes: Node 1's election timeout fires. It waited long enough without hearing from a leader. A timeout is not a safety decision. A timeout costs one round and nothing more.
Node 1 becomes a candidate at ballot 2.1: it wants the whole log suffix.
Node 1 raises its durable promise from 1.0 to 2.1. The promise is durable before anything leaves.
Node 1 campaigns at ballot 2.1. It sends one Prepare to 2 peers, and it claims every slot from 1 at once. Phase 1 asks about no value. It asks what the acceptors have already accepted.

Node 1 asks 2 peers for any slot from 1 it may have missed. It does not claim to be behind. A decision reaches a follower only as a commit watermark. A watermark that it did not receive looks the same as a watermark that was never set.

steps.label: Prepare 2.1
notes: Prepare at 2.1 for slots from 1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

steps.label: Prepare 2.1
notes: Node 2 receives Prepare 2.1 for every slot from 1. Its promise was 1.0. It holds 1 accepted record to report.
Node 2 raises its durable promise from 1.0 to 2.1, and reports what it accepted: nothing. Every ballot below 2.1 is fenced out here from now on.

steps.label: CatchUpRequest
notes: Catch me up from slot 1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

steps.label: CatchUpRequest
notes: Node 2 receives a catch-up request from node 1: it is missing everything from slot 1.

steps.label: Promise 2.1
notes: Node 1 receives a Promise for ballot 2.1 from node 2. The Promise reports the 0 accepted values it holds at or above the slot the Prepare asked about.
Node 1 is the leader at ballot 2.1. A promise quorum answered its Prepare. No ballot below 2.1 can decide anything now, and node 1 may run Phase 2 alone.

Node 1 replaces its record for slot 1. It held bravo at ballot 1.0, and it now holds bravo at ballot 2.1. The record at the higher ballot replaces the record at the lower one, and that rule makes a restart safe.
Node 1 proposes bravo for slot 1 at ballot 2.1, to 2 acceptors. No second Phase 1 is needed. The ballot it holds already covers the whole log suffix.

steps.label: Accept 2.1 · slot 1
notes: Accept bravo at 2.1 for slot 1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

Node 1 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.

steps.label: Commit 2.1 · slot 1
notes: Commit slot 1 = bravo at 2.1 is lost. The protocol must treat a lost message and a partition the same way.

Node 2 learns that slot 1 is chosen as bravo at ballot 2.1.
Node 2 applies slot 1 = bravo. Its contiguous prefix now ends at slot 1.
